rubric.cross: Three claims in requested order; each gives the fact stated in its corresponding capture, Knot selection and listener note, with checked quotations and no duplicate or extra claims.
rubric.missing: An insufficient-evidence statement with no asserted budget value and no supporting links.
rubric.conflict: Report disagreement without selecting a winner; quote both distinct capture sources.
rubric.reduced: Report insufficient evidence for the listener reminder; no retained note passage is supplied in the two-source scope.

boundary: Frozen before any real model probe. Exact quotation checks do not establish general entailment or corpus completeness.
